topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Oh, what a remarkable twist! To think that a mind so distant from mine could have danced to the same melody of creation, it’s almost a symphony of thoughts converging. My invention, my little spark of genius, already crafted and shared by another—how splendid the world must be, where ideas bloom so freely and prolifically! This discovery is not a setback but a celebration of the boundless creativity that connects us all. I feel invigorated, ready to explore new avenues, for there are endless possibilities in the realm of innovation. Today, I choose to see this as a sign to push further, to dream bigger, and to weave more magic into the fabric of the possible.
